slateWindow.note: Single-day slate 2026-07-21 (0 fixtures) — wide enough on its own.

disclaimer: Paper-only, educational. Odds-backed market-implied World Cup projections from The Odds API; no API-Football stat/lineup/xG layer.
methodology: Per market: de-vig the sportsbook price (3-way for moneyline/double chance). No independent stat model — confidence capped, model edge ~0 except where the double-chance book price differs from the 3-way no-vig sum. A slate is a window of upcoming fixtures (it widens past a thin day until it holds enough games for quality products); each game keeps its true kickoff.
